title: workflow speed: a shared compiler cache (sccache) for every worktree's own target
goal: Each worktree builds into its own seeded target; the crates the seed cannot hold (the vendored path patches and everything above them, feature variants) still compile cold in every new worktree. A local sccache, configured once per machine by scripts/setup-sccache.sh and enabled by the worktree scripts, serves them from a content-addressed cache so a new worktree's first gate build is minutes, and N worktrees build at once with no shared lock.
